sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 560. Success value 100. 5x physical damage (Fire).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all allies. Activates Time Extend which increases the time advantageous effects (buffs, special buffs, and non-removable buffs) are applied to the target by 60 seconds for one time only.
-Target: all allies excluding yourself. Fills Unison gauge by 40.
-Target: all allies. Applies iron wall for 90 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Applies Grace for 90 seconds (increases max HP by 100%; nullifies Cost reduction, status ailments, and debuffs. After the effect ends, 100 Cost is restored to your character).
-Target: yourself. Applies Barracks for 120 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; [Special] increases all stats by 100%; [Special] increases critical hit chance by 100%; [Special] increases physical/magic attack Ability success value by 40; [Special] reduces cooldown time by 50%. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 20000
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 20000

[Beach Volleyball] Tao or Ninoyu with the same or higher Cost of the base Monster can be used as fodder.
 *Specific Monsters may also be used. See the Help section for details.
